python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# Export-Import Bank Total Direct Sales data (1963-1974)
sales = [366, 436, 124, 63, 153, 91, 379, 406, 269, 248, 145, 21]

# Calculate median
median = statistics.median(sales)
print(f"Values: {sorted(sales)}")
print(f"Median: {median}")

# 1974 value
value_1974 = 21

# Signed deviation
deviation = value_1974 - median
print(f"1974 value: {value_1974}")
print(f"Signed deviation: {deviation}")
print(f"Rounded to 1 decimal: {round(deviation, 1)}")
EOF
